credential_scan.scope: Recognizable plaintext credential fields and formats in exported payloads; no entropy-based or arbitrary-secret absence claim.

source_reference_method: Original questions use separately prepared pinned source references; derived aggregates are recomputed with SQLite over original full source records, without the runtime expected-answer function.

measurement_qualification.interpretation: A failed postcollection semantic quality check is retained separately from the unchanged original model gate and exact archive replay.

claim_limits: Output publication is not automatically communication
Read/action temporal association is not causality
